recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If FHIR-56195 or similar validator/version-precedence questions lead to changes, handle them in the FHIR Extension Pack or validator workflow rather than restoring event-basedOn to core.
issue_request: FHIR-27115 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that event-basedOn no longer be limited to Condition, but instead include other event resources where the Event.basedOn concept is applicable.
initial_application: Core commit 2aaccf071c30f8c22a283f5e9113c907e9a52bdb changed source/profiles/event-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from a Condition-only context to a broader event-resource context list. Another same-key commit, 6616e51d37fe83bbfebcdb574deb3ccc2cae86a3, changed unrelated profiling guidance and was not part of this extension application.
additional_context: Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions from the R5 core source, and a focused current-source search finds event-basedOn only in source/oids.ini. The current FHIR Extension Pack source defines StructureDefinition-event-basedOn with expanded contexts including Composition, while later FHIR-49697 intentionally removed DetectedIssue from that context list.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current core checkout is not missing a build-scope source fix: the seed was applied historically, the definition moved to the Extension Pack, and the current Extension Pack source preserves the broadened contexts as modified by later decisions.
